title: Send your first email
subtitle: Test delivery and prepare your own API integration.

demo.title: Try a platform email
demo.body: This demonstration is sent from {from} only to {to}. No API key or domain setup is needed.

step1.title: Add an API key
step1.body: Keys authenticate every request. The full key is shown once, at creation.

step2.title: Send through the API
step2.bodyLocked: To your own inbox, from a domain you verify — the snippet unlocks once you have a key.
step2.bodyReady: Your key and your inbox are pre-filled. Verify your own domain, use a sender from it, then run the snippet from your terminal.
step2.subject: It works.
step2.sentTo: Send request accepted for {to}. Wait for the delivery event.
step2.selfHostBase: Self-hosted: set your SDK's base URL to {url}.
step2.sendLimited: A few onboarding emails already went out from this team. Try again in an hour.

step3.title: Watch it arrive
step3.waiting: waiting for your first email · checking every 5 s

success.title: Delivery confirmed
success.subtitle: Your team has confirmed deliveries. Review your current setup and send history below.
success.emailDelivered: Email sent · delivered to {to} in {seconds} s
success.counting: {count, plural, one {1 delivered. Counting.} other {# delivered. Counting.}}

attempt.label: Send history
attempt.inFlight: Send in transit — awaiting a delivery event. API acceptance is not delivery confirmation.
attempt.failed: This attempt ended without a confirmed delivery.
attempt.retryBody: Check the failure reason in the log and correct the recipient or sender settings before retrying. A new send happens only when you run the snippet or click the button.
attempt.readUnavailable: We could not load your current delivery status. Reload it before making another attempt; you can still open the email history.

explore.label: Explore more

mcp.title: Install MCP
mcp.body: Connect your AI tools and agents to send email through MepMail.

webhooks.title: Set up webhooks
webhooks.body: Delivery events, pushed to your endpoint as they happen.

team.title: Invite your team
team.body: Members manage emails, domains, and webhooks.

migrate.title: Migrate from Resend
migrate.body: One command moves contacts, segments, templates, webhooks and domains.

explore.instance: Send rate and email retention are instance settings — set them in <link>Settings</link>.

stepSes.title: Connect your AWS SES
stepSes.body: MepMail sends through your own AWS SES account. Connect it once in settings — the wizard creates everything and tests the connection.
